title: Chamberlain University to Open Salt Lake City Campus; Now Accepting Applications for Fall 2026
summary: Covista, America’s Largest Healthcare Educator, Opening First Utah Location to Help Address State's Critical Nursing Shortage New Campus will be Chamberlain's 26th Location Nationwide Chamberlain University, America’s largest school of nursing and a Covista institution, today announced it will open a new campus in Salt Lake City, Utah. The campus continues Chamberlain's national expansion strategy to address the U.S. healthcare workforce shortage. The university will begin accepting applications on July 21, 2026, with pre-licensure Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) classes beginning October 26, 2026. The announcement comes as the region grapples with one of the most acute healthcare worker shortages in the nation. According to the Covista Care Capacity Monitor , fielded by Gallup, Utah has the lowest number of nurses per capita of any state, just 7 per 1,000 residents, and the gap is widening.
